def _parse_to_end(inline: 'InlineParser', m: Match[str], state:
    'InlineState', tok_type: str, end_pattern: Pattern[str]) ->Optional[int]:
    text = m.group(0)
    start = m.end()
    end = -1
    while True:
        match = end_pattern.search(state.src, start)
        if not match:
            break
        end = match.end()
        start = end
        # Check if we found a valid ending sequence
        if match.group(0) == match.group(0)[-2:]:
            break
    if end == -1:
        return None
    new_state = state.copy()
    new_state.src = text[2:-2]
    children = inline.render(new_state)
    state.append_token({
        'type': tok_type,
        'children': children
    })
    return end
